column4: brief
Something to collect, and a hill to do it on.
Ramps, and ground that gives way.
Green metal. Get on it and stay on.
Ride the arches. They give the hill back.
Ten of them, and never where you already are.
Leave nothing shining behind you.
Find the rails. Ride them properly.
Tuck low and let the hill do the work.
A bit of everything, and no time to spare.
Prove you have learned the whole ridge.
Crystals everywhere, ramps in between.
Rails pay, and they pay while you are on them.
One number matters. Make it big.
Sweep the hill, gates and all.
Every ramp you can reach, and what lies between.
Crystals, and the idols among them.
Metal first, everything else after.
Ride every gate you can reach.
All three, all at once, all downhill.
The last run before the sun goes.
The idols are out tonight.
Let the ground do the work.
Ramp to gate, all the way down.
High walls. Use them.
Everything on the hill is worth points.
The road never lets you settle.
Narrow, and the gates are on the edges.
Wide open and a long way down.
Every drop pays if you land it.
Idols in the bowl. Go and get them.
Rails first. Everything else after.
Never stop accelerating.
Leave nothing on the hill.
Chain it. That is the only way.
Three demands, one short clock.
Ramps into gates, and nothing slower.
Idols on the tightest hill there is.
Nothing held back.
Everything you have learned, at once.
Everything the ridge has, one last time.
